thesis_alignments.thesis_summary: Pre-empt-friendly Series A and B in B2B SaaS, developer tools, and infrastructure. Bias toward technical founders who have shipped at scale. Avoid pure marketplaces and ad-supported consumer.
Seed and Series A across vertical SaaS, especially fintech-adjacent and HR-tech. Operator-led firm; partners do their own diligence calls. Slow to first call, fast to term sheet once engaged.
Growth-stage focus, $10M+ checks at Series B and C. Strong portfolio in B2B SaaS infrastructure. Diligence-heavy: expect 3+ customer reference calls and a competitive teardown before partner meeting.
thesis_alignments.portfolio_overlap: adjacent: DataPipeCo (shared with Acme); competitive: none

deck_share_policy: per-recipient-per-version; watermark required; outreach_log entry mandatory
term_sheet_policy: founder-only; coordinator role is logistics and notes capture
negotiation_policy: never; every negotiation-shaped ask escalates verbatim to founder
